alpha_selection: Pooled inner GroupKFold RMSE, ties prefer larger alpha
fit_membership: Join groups to oof_predictions.csv. Inner training uses outer train_groups minus inner val_groups.
distant75_definition: Frozen rows at Levenshtein distance >=3 from FACS train/val and the row's SPR outer training fold

bootstrap.method: Within each subset, resample original groups with replacement, pair all models on each draw, no refits

position_ridge.preprocessing: Fixed sparse one-hot features and train-only intercept centering
position_ridge.solver: Centered dual Gram matrix, positive-definite solve

position_pairwise_ridge.preprocessing: Fixed sparse one-hot features and train-only intercept centering
position_pairwise_ridge.solver: Centered dual Gram matrix, positive-definite solve

facs_transformer.preprocessing: Frozen dense features and train-only StandardScaler and intercept centering
facs_transformer.solver: Centered dual Gram matrix, positive-definite solve

p_facs_high.preprocessing: Frozen FACS high probability from the original SPR OOF CSV

configuration.checkpoint_selection: highest validation high-class AP; ties use earliest epoch
